Add a styled basemap layer to a tmap v4 pipeline.

Source: R/tmap_integration.R
tm_basemap.Rd

Returns a deferred tmap element that renders tiles at draw time using the bounding box resolved from the active tm_shape() — no explicit bbox argument is needed. This mirrors how tmap's own tm_basemap() works. Takes the same arguments as geom_basemap(), plus the view size.

Usage

tm_basemap(
  style,
  tile_zoom = NULL,
  alpha = 1,
  layers = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  features = NULL,
  pixel_ratio = NULL,
  auth_token = NULL,
  tile_timeout_ms = 10000L,
  max_tiles = 256L,
  attribution = TRUE,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

style

A MapLibre GL style URL or JSON string (e.g. from basemap_provider()), or a vector / list of styles stacked bottom to top.

tile_zoom

Tile detail override: the tile zoom on the 256 px grid (vector sources use one less, their tiles being 512 px), or NULL to pick tiles as MapLibre does for the view.

alpha

Opacity of the basemap layer (0–1).

layers

Optional layer filter applied to every style: plain IDs keep only those layers, minus-prefixed IDs drop them; * and ? are wildcards ("-label_*"). See list_layers(). Names that match no layer of any style warn.

labels

TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops the labels (text and icons), "only" keeps only the labels on a transparent background, to stack over another map. Catalogue raster basemaps switch to their label-free or label-only tiles.

features

Optional feature filter applied to every style: plain names keep those features, minus-prefixed names drop them, e.g. c("water", "roads") or "-buildings". Features: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi, terrain, other (the feature column of list_layers()). Features no layer of any style belongs to warn.

pixel_ratio

Device pixels per CSS pixel: the basemap raster is width * pixel_ratio by height * pixel_ratio pixels with the same zoom and label layout. Default: device dpi / 96 (300 dpi for PDF / SVG devices), so tmap_save(dpi = 300) gets a basemap rendered at 300 dpi.

auth_token

Optional access token for the tile service.

tile_timeout_ms

Per-tile HTTP timeout in milliseconds.

max_tiles

Maximum tiles fetched per style.

attribution

The credit line the basemap's providers ask for, as a tmap::tm_credits() element in the bottom-right corner: TRUE (the default) for the styles' own (see get_attribution()), FALSE for none, or your own text.

width, height

View size in CSS pixels (sets the zoom). By default the map panel's size is estimated from the device size, margins and facet layout, at 96 CSS px per inch.

...

Reserved for future use.

Value

A composable tmap element (class "tmap"). Put it before tm_shape() so it renders behind subsequent layers.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(tmap)
library(sf)
nc <- st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
basemapper::tm_basemap("OpenFreeMap.Positron") +
  tm_shape(nc) +
  tm_sf(fill = NA, col = "steelblue")
} # }
